sourceProof: The 36 UInt16 indices name eight existing vertex IDs. Every output slot reaches the same CUBE_VERT after the unchanged per-triangle cyclic rotation; all 12 ordered triangles retain their first-vertex flat value and all per-corner smooth inputs. Run reads sourceVertex only for CUBE_VERT (NativeGroundDecalShaders.h:12-55,197-321,372-382).
Vertex and fragment shaders, arguments, depth/cull/blend state and atlas draw are unchanged. The indexed path changes only the GroundDecal surface cube submission (Metal4GroundDecal.mm:49-80).

The local MTL4 SDK header MTL4RenderCommandEncoder.h:383-425 specifies count in elements, length in bytes, UInt16 two-byte alignment, and zero baseVertex/baseInstance semantics. Policy checks address/length; the draw uses 36 indices, actual buffer length and both bases zero.

The fixed 72-byte upload uses existing Buffer and RuntimeLease::AddAllocation, which retains the exact allocation for the frame (Metal4GroundDecal.mm:11,163-179; Metal4RuntimeNative.mm:769-782). PreparedGroundDecal also keeps a strong buffer handle until Encode. No cache or producer write is added.

Optional nil allocation and invalid index address/length use the old draw; lease/state errors propagate. Selector check happens before either draw and there is no catch/retry after submission. Existing completion packet owns PreparedGroundDecal through normal retirement (Metal4GroundDecal.mm:68-80,163-179; Metal4WorldRenderer.mm:5783-5807,5840-5864).
OFF performs no index allocation and the old draw. PROBE=0 avoids reason updates, counters and logging; the remaining additions are gate initialization and a branch.
